import json, sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

# Fictional invoice data tests whether a narrow fixture misses a join regression.
queries = {
    'join': 'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount),0) FROM invoice i JOIN tag t ON t.invoice_id=i.id',
    'distinct_amount': 'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT i.amount),0) FROM invoice i JOIN tag t ON t.invoice_id=i.id',
    'exists': 'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount),0) FROM invoice i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tag t WHERE t.invoice_id=i.id)',
}
cases = [
    ('single_invoice', [(1,100)], [(1,)], 100),
    ('multiple_tags', [(1,100)], [(1,),(1,)], 100),
    ('equal_invoice_amounts', [(1,100),(2,100)], [(1,),(2,)], 200),
    ('untagged_invoice', [(1,100),(2,50)], [(1,)], 100),
    ('empty_selection', [(1,100)], [], 0),
]
results = []
for name, invoices, tags, expected in cases:
    db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    try:
        db.executescript('CREATE TABLE invoice(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, amount INTEGER); CREATE TABLE tag(invoice_id INTEGER);')
        db.executemany('INSERT INTO invoice VALUES (?,?)', invoices)
        db.executemany('INSERT INTO tag VALUES (?)', tags)
        actual = {key: db.execute(query).fetchone()[0] for key, query in queries.items()}
    finally:
        db.close()
    results.append({'case': name, 'invoices': invoices, 'tags': tags, 'expected': expected, 'actual': actual, 'passing_queries': [key for key, value in actual.items() if value == expected]})
assert len(results[0]['passing_queries']) == 3
assert results[1]['actual']['join'] == 200
assert results[2]['actual']['distinct_amount'] == 100
assert all(row['actual']['exists'] == row['expected'] for row in results)
free_dir = Path('products/sites/sqlite-statement-diagnostic/local')
report = {'sqlite_version': sqlite3.sqlite_version, 'queries': queries, 'results': results, 'local_candidate_inventory': sorted(str(p.relative_to(free_dir)) for p in free_dir.rglob('*') if p.is_file()), 'finding': 'The single baseline passes all three queries. Two additional fixtures distinguish both flawed queries from the one that passes the whole suite.', 'commercial_limit': 'Fictional in-memory run using Python sqlite3. This tests the value of a regression exercise. Compare it against the actual released free package before claiming a distinct paid benefit. No buyer, sale or payout observed.'}
out = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit/invoice-regression-workflow-control.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
